tag: UNVALIDATED — not proven; paper only until a fee-honest backtest passes
comment2: STRENGTH CLIMB (no profiles anymore — intervals are the profiles). The SMALLEST interval listed for an agent is its ENTRY (trading) lane; every interval LISTED above it is a climb rung (60m -> 240m -> 1440m) that must clear its own band before the entry lane may move. Listing only the entry interval = climb off = the lane trades on its own strength. Rung bands (entry_strength_max_<iv>/exit_strength_min_<iv>) are agent-tuned overrides that fall back to that agent's own entry_strength_max/exit_strength_min. The GUI builds this list from its entry button + the climb toggles.
comment3: OPT-IN STOP LOSS (per agent, GUI Settings -> Stop loss). Default OFF keeps the house rule: never sell at a loss. When ON, exits.py rests a maker LIMIT as price nears the stop (never a market dump). stop_mode: price_watch (fixed level) | trailing (level rides up with price). stop_loss_pct = flat stop %, null = use the decider's structural pos[stop]. trail_pct = trailing distance as % of ENTRY, null = the initial stop distance. watch_pct = how near (%) before the limit is armed.
